prompt: Create ONE polished production concept contact sheet for the existing stylized low-poly 3D game IRONFALL: an ARMORY of genuinely different wieldable clubs, hammers and shields, using navy/teal painted steel, brushed iron, warm gold fittings, leather wraps and real hardwood. Landscape 3:2 composition, high resolution, orderly dark teal industrial blueprint background, warm cream minimal typography. This is a new concept sheet, not a screenshot or fake game UI. Exactly 18 distinct numbered assets, fully visible, separated with generous negative space. Four horizontal rows: first row FOUR CLUBS numbered 01-04; second row FOUR ONE-HANDED HAMMERS numbered 05-08; third row FOUR TWO-HANDED HAMMERS numbered 09-12; fourth row SIX SHIELDS numbered 13-18. The first three rows have four larger cells each; the final row has six shield cells. Small header 'IRONFALL / ARMORY CONCEPT'. Row headings only 'CLUBS', 'ONE HAND', 'TWO HAND', 'SHIELDS'. Each asset has its two-digit number clearly below it, no lengthy names. Consistent three-quarter view, orthographic-like perspective, studio lighting, crisp bevels, mechanically plausible sockets and gripping zones. No people, no hands, no bikes, no pedestal, no swords, no axes, no guns, no floating disconnected fragments, no decorative stars. These must be visibly varied SHAPES and constructions, never repeated silhouettes with color swaps. 01: knotted dense hardwood cudgel with a naturally swollen asymmetric head continuing along the shaft. 02: thick iron-banded wooden baseball-like war club with rows of restrained metal studs, dark wrapped grip. 03: cylindrical metal impact club with six longitudinal blunt flanges and a narrow mechanical handle. 04: long tapered octagonal steel-and-wood studded club, heavy rounded blunt end with a distinct forward canted profile and reinforced knuckle guard. 05: compact classic T-shaped rectangular double-face iron hammer, short one-hand leather shaft. 06: short-handled double cylindrical engineering hammer with circular striking faces, visibly round rather than rectangular. 07: asymmetric one-handed cross-peen hammer, one broad square striking face and one narrow blunt wedge-peen opposite, no axe blade, gold brace. 08: twin-piston powered one-hand hammer, two parallel chunky cylinders joined as a crosshead with visible steel braces and a small cyan core in a central socket. 09: very wide rectangular sledgehammer with a long straight reinforced wood haft, heavy steel end caps and waist bands. 10: huge hexagonal barrel-headed two-hand maul, round-ish six-sided striking faces and a long curved reinforced haft. 11: broad heavy two-hand wrecking hammer with a flat steel striking face and short conical studs, articulated shock absorber neck and a long two-hand grip. 12: imposing storm reactor hammer with a thick open-ring mechanical crosshead inside a U-shaped armored housing, real central opening, gold steel ribs, long shaft, small contained cyan electrical core. Shields: 13 round wooden-and-steel buckler with a raised gold central boss. 14 tapered long kite shield with overlapping blue steel plates and a raised central spine. 15 tall rectangular heavy tower shield with layered corner armor and narrow inset viewport. 16 compact solid hexagonal shield with chamfered steel edges, cyan-powered inset core and a grounded solid blue center panel, not an ethereal bubble. 17 a broad articulated folding riot shield made of three hinged vertical metal leaves with visible rivets and a reinforced lower edge. 18 a distinctive pointed teardrop shield with a thick gold split-crest frame, double layered shoulder lobes and solid dark steel face. All grips and shafts must connect continuously and appear usable, with clear one-hand vs two-hand grip lengths. Match a coherent charming industrial game asset style with substantial readable 3D forms; high-quality illustrated 3D concepts, not photorealistic photos. A narrow bottom strip illustrates four small interchangeable physical core cartridges labeled 'IMPACT', 'ARC', 'FIRE', 'FROST': respectively an amber steel shock piston, a cyan electrical coil, an orange combustion vent capsule, a pale icy cooling cell. These effect cores are modular options for the weapon families, not merely color themes or forced assignments. Keep their visual effects restrained and attached to their housings. Prioritize the 18 weapon/shield silhouettes and number accuracy over background decoration. No additional text, no illegible stat bars, no promises of implemented features.
